step3_mechanism.chosen: The conformant bake CLI (legacy-design-tools, nodeFacetBakeTier1ConformantCli.ts) permanently skips writing a row -- on every run, forever -- when the parcel is still present on its county's current CAD roll (not a CTX-RETIRE roll-absent/retired case) AND the CAD claim's raw situsAddress is punctuation-only. Verified at source, origin/main 3885efad: situsForBake() calls assertSitusNotPunctuationOnly (serveGuards.ts, PUNCTUATION_ONLY_RE = /^[\s,.\-;:'"`]+$/); when it throws, situsForBake returns {situs:null, refuse:true}; the per-row loop does `skippedBadSitus += 1; continue` BEFORE any write (nodeFacetBakeTier1ConformantCli.ts:341-345). A skipped row is never touched again on any future run, so it stays frozen on whatever bakedAt/schema it last held.
evidence: 100% match, not a sample: every one of the 18,037 failing rows across all three counties has a punctuation-only baseFacts.situsAddress (measured live: 16104/16104 Bastrop, 768/768 Hays, 1165/1165 McLennan).

100% match: every failing row carries provenance.parcelSource = 'txgio', the pre-conformant bake's literal marker (ParcelSource union in nodeFacetTier1Assemble.ts is exactly 'txgio' | 'conformant-v1-cad-parcel-roll') -- none carry the conformant source.

bakedAt is frozen and disjoint from passing rows in every county checked: Hays and McLennan's failing rows share ONE exact bakedAt timestamp each (2026-07-23T15:22:13.921Z and 2026-07-24T19:33:06.683Z respectively) while passing rows in the same county were baked today (2026-09-09), hours-to-months later, repeatedly -- the failing set has not moved across any of those later runs.

Source read directly (not inferred from CTX-RETIRE's prose): nodeFacetBakeTier1ConformantCli.ts's rollAbsent branch (situsForRetiredBake, CTX-RETIRE PR #647, merged today as 3885efad -- the exact LDT_SHA this dispatch's publish image is pinned to) explicitly bypasses the punctuation guard ONLY when cadPropertyRoll.byPropId lacks the prop_id. Every failing row here IS present on its roll (confirmed for 48309:103671: real baseFacts, no recordRetirement field), so it takes the untouched `else` branch and hits the pre-existing skip.
step3_mechanism.rejected: Matching Caldwell's 48055:1 class (a roll-dropout / retired account). Rejected on two independent grounds: (1) the dispatch's own instruction that McLennan holds a single CAD vintage and cannot have a roll-dropout population; (2) live-verified -- 48309:103671's served payload carries no recordRetirement field at all, and its provenance/situs shape matches the on-roll `else` branch of the bake CLI, not the rollAbsent branch. The two failure classes share a root CODE PATH (the same punctuation guard in situsForBake) but are DIFFERENT POPULATIONS: roll-absent accounts (Caldwell, now fixed by PR #647) versus live on-roll accounts with a blank/placeholder CAD situs (this dispatch's 18,037, still unfixed). Caldwell's 0/48,649 current failure count corroborates this: PR #647's fix already resolved its roll-absent population; the on-roll punctuation-skip defect this dispatch found is untouched by that fix and has no representation in Caldwell today because none of Caldwell's on-roll accounts happen to carry a punctuation-only situs (or if any do, they are a separate, unmeasured question the dispatch did not name).
